description: XAUUSD positioning (COT) + cross-asset (DXY) mechanisms. Data that was previously missing is now available: CFTC COT disaggregated positioning 2021-2026 (data/cot/) and DXY 2018-2026 (data/DXY_D1.csv). XAUUSD costs verified correct (0.65 bps rt, commission=0).
current_verdict_2026-08-06: 3007 INCONCLUSIVE (3t), 3003 REJECTED, 3008 INCONCLUSIVE (8t), 3009 INCONCLUSIVE (8t). COT mechanism underpowered at weekly frequency.
notes: Registered 2026-08-06 BEFORE running any backtest (F27 discipline).
Both mechanisms have economic rationale: positioning extremes historically precede gold reversals; USD (DXY) direction leads gold (inverse correlation).
XAUUSD was NOT affected by the commission unit error (commission=0 on Pepperstone Razor commodities CFD) — prior XAUUSD REJECTs stand; these are NEW mechanisms on the same instrument.

result_summary.conclusion: INCONCLUSIVE: only 3 z>=2.0 positioning-extreme events in 5 years of COT data (2021-2026). Underpowered by construction — min-trades gate (30) not met. Managed Money net positioning rarely reaches 2-sigma extremes on gold. z threshold too strict for 5-year window.

hypotheses.notes: Direction J trial 3007 — INCONCLUSIVE (insufficient signal frequency, not loss). No verdict change possible with 3 trades.

result_summary.conclusion: REJECTED: DXY z>=1.0 momentum lead-lag loses massively (dk_t=-15.5, mean -/trade, 245 trades). Trading gold AGAINST DXY extremes is strongly wrong — gold and USD do NOT lead-lag in the hypothesized direction at 5-day horizon. Hypothesis falsified.

hypotheses.notes: Direction J trial 3003 — REJECTED. DXY lead-lag hypothesis falsified (contra-direction loses).

result_summary.conclusion: z>=1.5 gives 58 extreme weeks but only 8 trades after hold/exit logic (exit z=0.5 + re-entry lag). Underpowered — min-trades gate (30) not met. INCONCLUSIVE per pre-registered gate.

hypotheses.notes: Direction J trial 3008 — INCONCLUSIVE (8 trades < 30 gate). COT weekly frequency structurally limits trade count.

result_summary.conclusion: Swap-dealer cohort z>=1.5 also yields only 8 trades. Underpowered — gate not met. INCONCLUSIVE per pre-registered gate.

hypotheses.notes: Direction J trial 3009 — INCONCLUSIVE (8 trades < 30 gate). COT weekly frequency structurally limits trade count.
